class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, key, value):
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.left = None
        self.right = None
        self.height = 1  




class BTS(tree)=深度定制各种方法
    def init (key,value)
                    super.init(key,value)
            
            
            def search (key)
                    super.search(key)
                    

    
    
            def insert (key,value,self,root)
                    if not root
                        return TreeNode(key, value)
                    if key < root.key
                        root.left = self.insert(key, value, self, root.left)
                    elif key > root.key
                        root.right = self.insert(key, value, self, root.right)
                    else
                        root.value = value
                        return root
            def left_reserve(self, root)
                if not root
                    return root
                new_root = self.left_reserve(root.right)
            

            def right_reserve(self, root)
                if not root or not root.left
                    return root
                new_root = root.left
                root.left = new_root.right
                new_root.right = root
                root.parent = new_root
                root.height = 1 + max(self.get_height(root.left), self.get_height(root.right))
                root.left = root.left.right
                if root.left
                    root.left.parent = root
